title: Keychron announces first open-source firmware for gaming mice
summary: Keychron, a peripheral manufacturer known for mechanical keyboards, has announced its first open-source firmware for gaming mice, marking a significant move toward transparency and community-driven hardware development in the gaming peripherals market.
problem_solved: Enables users to inspect, modify, and customize their gaming mouse firmware instead of being locked into proprietary software.
why_valuable: Open-source firmware empowers users with full control over their hardware, promotes security transparency, and allows the community to contribute improvements and fixes.
